spec: DIAGNOSTIC-LONG-1.md Section 1. Measurement only. D1 and D2 are the v8 T4 and T6 goals; D3 to D5 are new and diagnostic only: never reused in a campaign.

tasks.goal: Create the file docs/GUIDE.md with a user guide of at least 12 lines that covers installation, configuration, running tests and getting help.
Create the file docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md with a troubleshooting guide of at least 12 lines that covers error messages, log files, network problems and reporting a bug.
Create the file docs/ARCHITECTURE.md describing the architecture of a small command line tool in at least 20 lines, covering the main components, the data flow, error handling and how to extend it.
Create the file docs/CONTRIBUTING.md with contributor instructions of at least 15 lines covering setting up a development environment, coding style, submitting a change and the review process.
Create the file docs/FAQ.md with a list of at least 10 frequently asked questions and answers about installing, updating, uninstalling and backing up a command line tool.
